chapter.heading: Psalm 101
I Will Walk with Integrity
A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
I will
sing of,
steadfast love and justice; to you, O LORD, I will make music.

I will
not set,
before my eyes anything that is worthless. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.

A perverse
heart shall,
be far from me; I will know nothing of evil.

Whoever slanders
his neighbor,
secretly I will destroy. Whoever has a haughty look and an arrogant heart I will not endure.

I will
look with,
favor on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way that is blameless shall minister to me.

No one
who practices,
deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who utters lies shall continue before my eyes.

Morning by
morning I,
will destroy all the wicked in the land, cutting off all the evildoers from the city of the LORD. (ESV)
